questions.prompt: Which Indian mission first found signs of water on the Moon?
What is the SI unit of force?
Which scientist gave the theory of relativity?
Which particle carries a negative charge?
What is the name of India's first mission to study the Sun?
Which force keeps the Moon in orbit around the Earth?
Absolute zero is zero on which temperature scale?
What do we call the huge explosion of a dying star?
Which galaxy is our solar system a part of?
Which planet takes the shortest time to go around the Sun?

story.intro: Welcome to the night observatory, engineer! The comet clock crashed right before launch, and only you can reboot it. Every right answer turns one golden gear.
chapters: Gear one is spinning. Nice start, engineer!
The telescope just powered up. Keep going!
The star charts are loading. Brilliant!
Half the gears are running. You're halfway through the build!
The comet's tail is glowing brighter. Superb!
The planets are back in line. You're on fire!
One last gear to go. Stay focused!
You did it! The comet clock is ticking again!
setbacks: Oops! A cloud drifted over the lens.
Hmm, a gear slipped. Debug and move on.
Never mind, listen to the next one.

endings.great: You're a true star engineer! The whole sky is back in sync.
endings.good: Solid run! Most of the stars have found their way.
endings.try_again: A few gears are still stuck. Revise a little and try again!
